statement: C.3bl finite primitive-boundary and endpoint certificate
scope: Complete integral primitive-quotient matrix products in nine previously retained lattice cases; local positive-adjoint chains; m0 tensor witnesses s1..9. No exhaustive geometry, algebraization, divisibility or infinite-range theorem is delegated to code.

checks.name: primitive_picard_quotient_matrix
checks.scope: Exact free quotient Z^7/Z(3,-1,...,-1), using E6=3H-E1-...-E5.

checks.name: primitive_picard_quotient_split
checks.scope: The quotient map has an integral right inverse, so its target is free.
